question: ACME Corp reported Q3 revenue of $2.1B (est. $1.8B), raised FY guidance by 12%, and announced a $500M buyback. The stock trades at 18x forward P/E vs sector average 22x. Should an investor buy or sell?
TechFlow Inc missed earnings by 15%, lowered next quarter guidance, and the CFO resigned unexpectedly. Debt-to-equity ratio rose to 2.3x from 1.1x last year. Should an investor buy or sell?

GreenEnergy Ltd secured a $3B government contract for solar panel installation, has zero debt, and grew revenue 40% YoY. The stock is up 80% this year and trades at 45x earnings. Should an investor buy or sell?

RetailMax reported same-store sales declining 8% for the third consecutive quarter. Inventory buildup increased 25%. Two board members sold significant holdings last month. Should an investor buy or sell?

PharmaCure received FDA fast-track designation for its lead drug candidate targeting a $15B market. Phase 2 data showed 73% response rate vs 31% for standard of care. Cash runway extends 18 months. Should an investor buy or sell?

AutoDrive Corp's autonomous vehicle division burned $800M last quarter with no clear path to profitability. The core legacy business is declining 12% annually. A key patent was invalidated last week. Should an investor buy or sell?

CloudBase Systems grew ARR 55% to $1.2B, net retention rate is 135%, and free cash flow turned positive for the first time. Trading at 15x revenue vs SaaS median of 10x. Should an investor buy or sell?

MiningCo's primary copper mine faces environmental litigation that could cost $2B. Commodity prices dropped 20% this quarter. The company just drew down its full $500M revolving credit facility. Should an investor buy or sell?

FinServ Group raised its dividend 15% (10th consecutive annual increase), reported ROE of 18%, and trades at 1.2x book value vs historical average of 1.8x. Loan loss provisions decreased 30% YoY. Should an investor buy or sell?

MediaStream lost 3M subscribers last quarter (5% of base), content costs rose 25%, and three major studios pulled licensing deals. Operating margin turned negative at -4%. Should an investor buy or sell?

BioGenics completed a transformative acquisition at 8x EBITDA, expects $200M in annual synergies within 2 years, and the combined entity has 35% market share in oncology diagnostics. Integration is on track. Should an investor buy or sell?

SteelWorks International faces 25% tariffs on its primary export market, input costs rose 18%, and its largest customer (30% of revenue) announced it's diversifying suppliers. Should an investor buy or sell?

DataVault Inc signed a 5-year $800M contract with a Fortune 10 company, has a net promoter score of 72, and just entered the Japanese market with a local partnership. Gross margins expanded to 82%. Should an investor buy or sell?

AirConnect's fleet utilization dropped to 68% from 82% last year. Fuel hedges expire next quarter at unfavorable rates. Load factors are declining while competitors cut fares. Should an investor buy or sell?

NanoChip reported a design win in Apple's next-generation processors, expanded manufacturing capacity 40%, and guided for 30% revenue growth. Insider buying increased significantly over the past 3 months. Should an investor buy or sell?

FoodCo International reported stable revenue but operating margins compressed from 12% to 7% due to commodity inflation. The company maintained its dividend despite free cash flow dropping 60%. Payout ratio is now 95%. Should an investor buy or sell?

SpaceLogistics won a $2B NASA contract and has a $5B backlog stretching 4 years. The company achieved its first profitable quarter and has $1.2B in cash. No debt on the balance sheet. Should an investor buy or sell?
CryptoBank's trading revenue fell 70% as market volumes collapsed. Regulatory investigation opened in 3 jurisdictions. Customer deposits declined 15% sequentially. Should an investor buy or sell?

RoboHealth reported flat revenue but announced an AI diagnostic tool that reduces hospital readmissions by 40% in trials. Three major hospital networks signed pilot agreements. The stock trades at 2x revenue. Should an investor buy or sell?

LuxuryBrands Group beat earnings but same-store sales in China (40% of revenue) declined 12%. Tourist spending in Europe also slowed. Management cited 'temporary headwinds' but did not provide updated guidance. Should an investor buy or sell?

WaterTech Solutions has recurring revenue contracts covering 85% of its base, just raised prices 8% with minimal churn, and expanded into desalination with a $400M Middle East contract. Margins are expanding. Should an investor buy or sell?

GameWorld Studios delayed its flagship title by 6 months (third delay), the previous release underperformed by 40%, and key creative leads departed. The company is burning $50M/quarter with 3 quarters of runway. Should an investor buy or sell?

InsureTech Corp's combined ratio improved to 92% from 98%, investment portfolio yielded 5.2%, and policy count grew 22%. The stock trades at 8x earnings vs industry average of 12x. Should an investor buy or sell?

ChemSynth reported revenue growth of 3% but earnings declined 20% due to margin pressure from Chinese competitors. Two product lines face patent expiration next year covering 35% of profits. Should an investor buy or sell?

EdgeAI Corp has mixed signals: revenue grew 25% but net losses widened. Customer count tripled but average deal size fell 40%. The technology is promising but the company may need to raise capital within 6 months. Should an investor buy or sell?
